### Fixed
- **The kagent line re-pins to `v0.11.0-gs.2`** (giantswarm/giantswarm#37010, giantswarm/agent-platform#345 criterion 5). The line's first release `v0.11.0-gs.1` (commit `0ac5240`) predated the two carried patches the platform depends on, so 4.0 shipped a controller image without them: the trusted-proxy authenticator (giantswarm/kagent-upstream#9 — the controller re-derives the caller from the bearer's verified `email` claim instead of trusting `X-User-Id`) and `helm.sh/resource-policy: keep` on the five `kagent-crds` CRD templates (#10 — an uninstall no longer deletes the CRDs and every `AgentTemplate`/`RemoteMCPServer` with them). `v0.11.0-gs.2` (commit `3bdff381`) carries both. `kagent.tag` moves to `0.11.0-gs.2` (the controller and UI image build) and `kagent.harness.image` to the `gs.2` Go ADK index digest (meta and connectivity charts); `components.kagent`/`components.kagent-crds` keep the range `>=0.11.0-gs.1 <0.11.1-0` (a prerelease floor Masterminds admits `gs.2` above). With the controller on `gs.2`, **agent-platform#345 criterion 5 holds**: reached directly, bypassing agentgateway, a request with a forged `x-user-id` is attributed to the bearer's `email`, not the header (`kagent.controller.auth.mode: trusted-proxy`, `userIdClaim: email`, unchanged 4.0 defaults). Lab-proven on agentlab against the `gs.2` build: a port-forward to `kagent-controller`, `kagent.api.v1alpha1.SystemService/GetCurrentUser` returned the admin bearer's `email` while a forged `x-user-id: someone-else@evil.test` was ignored, a bearer-less call was refused (`Unauthenticated`), `/health` stayed `200`, and the five CRDs carried `helm.sh/resource-policy: keep`. `examples/customer-bom.yaml` and `tests/verify-kagent-crds.py` (`KAGENT_LINE_REF`) move with the pin. **No installation acts** — the release stays inert behind the fleet's `<4.0.0` bound.
